turns.question: Volvo D13C, VIN TESTVIN1233456566. P0299 and P0101. Power drops when climbing hills; no unusual noise. What should I check?
turns.title: Power loss: inspect intake and boost connections
turns.body:
These illustrative codes and observations point to an intake/airflow or boost issue. Inspect accessible intake hoses, clamps and wiring with the engine stopped. Arrange professional diagnosis to compare measured airflow and boost against manufacturer specifications.
